F1.name: Output Representational Gap
F1.question: Can a task separate a positive witness from cheap full-history controls by output accuracy?
F1.reason: 001B already showed that the K-window residue collapses under fair full-history controls.

F2.name: Process / Intervention Gap
F2.question: Can a mechanism be distinguished by how its internal state changes under controlled interventions, even if cheap controls match output labels?
F2.primary_risk: cheap controls may reproduce shallow traces

F3.name: Adaptation-Under-Distribution-Shift Gap
F3.question: Can a mechanism update from new experience in a way that cheap static controls cannot match without retraining or forbidden post-hoc access?
F3.reason: Viable only if cheap online controls with the same update access are included and fail.

F4.name: Causal Model Update Gap
F4.question: Can the mechanism update an internal causal model from interventions rather than merely fitting observed correlations?
F4.reason: Viable only if full-history causal tables, graph cache, and model-based controls are included and fail.

F5.name: Viability / Value-State Update Gap
F5.question: Can a bounded system update action preferences from internal viability/error signals rather than external labels alone?
F5.reason: Too close to value, affect, or subjectivity language unless a stricter non-companion contract exists.

F6.name: Replay / Consolidation Reframing
F6.question: Is there any replay/consolidation problem that avoids the prior graph-cache collapse?
F6.reason: Gate1 lineage is closed and same-agent bridge is blocked.
